description:
We are a collaborative team of Computer Science students with skills in AI, Machine Learning, Data Science, Python, SQL, Computer Vision, Cloud Computing, and 3D Modeling. We aim to use technology and open data to support future Moon and Mars exploration.

We're looking for teammates skilled in GIS, Remote Sensing, Geology, Planetary Science, Aerospace, Web Development, and UI/UX. Curiosity, creativity, and teamwork are always welcome!
